purpose: Test whether the ORION language backbone can learn a U-dependent, auditable observation-to-epistemic-limit-to-task-binding-to-decision process across the existing 17-event bank, and whether four partially unfrozen decoder layers materially improve over LoRA without changing the causal U/R/K architecture.

architecture.stage1_observation_uncertainty: Frozen task-agnostic spatial and temporal U tokens.
architecture.task_relevance_pass: A U-independent first ORION/VLM pass over clean visual context, view-aligned evidence and route text predicts factorized route and conflict-actor R.
architecture.language_pass: The same ORION language backbone receives 529 native visual tokens, 600 frozen Stage1 U tokens and 150 detached R hidden tokens directly, then predicts four explicitly tagged process steps.
architecture.r_language_pool: A fixed parameter-free per-view average pool converts the 10x10 R hidden grid to 5x5 for the language pass; the factorized R head and direct map supervision remain at 10x10.
architecture.posthoc_task_risk_diagnostic: K = U * max(sigmoid(route_R), sigmoid(actor_R)) is computed only to audit the controlled counterfactual bank and never conditions the model.

data_scope.development_evaluation: One fixed keyframe per event, all four controlled variants, target/counterfactual scored answers and exact no-U ablation.

training.event_sampling: Round-robin over thirteen train events with deterministic within-event keyframe shuffling.
training.variant_sampling: Deterministic rotation through all four controlled-U variants.

hard_stop_conditions: Any frozen input, protocol, arm preflight, launch amendment or submission attestation hash differs.
Any process dataset group violates zero-U, epistemic-limit, on/off-path or view-shuffle semantics.
Any trainable parameter lies outside the authorized capacity arm.
Any gradient reaches Stage1 or the U tokenizer.
Any required loss, gradient or output becomes non-finite.
Any output directory is non-empty before launch.
claim_boundary: A completed arm is a bounded controlled-U language-capacity smoke. It may establish process learnability under this supervised bank, but it is not learned-U generalization, formal Stage2-L, trajectory, closed-loop or safety evidence.
